summary: Meta Superintelligence Labs launched Muse Image and previewed Muse Video, its first media-generation model family, featuring agentic tool use, self-refinement, and test-time compute scaling for image and video generation.

mechanisms.reason: The model is designed to spend more compute at inference via reasoning, tool calls, and self-refinement steps, directly increasing per-request compute consumption.
mechanisms.quote: With more test-time compute, the model reasons more, uses more tool calls, and uses more self-refinement steps to improve its generations.

practices.reason: A newly released model family adds agentic tool use, test-time reasoning, and multi-reference image composition, but results are from the lab's own internal ablations rather than independent evaluation.
practices.quote: Instead of directly mapping prompts to images, Muse Image operates as an agent: it invokes search and coding tools to improve accuracy, self-refines its own generations, and improves through scaling test-time compute.

practices.reason: The model's standing is reported via an external human-preference Arena leaderboard, a measurement approach worth noting but not a method the document hands over for internal use.
practices.quote: Muse Image holds the No. 2 spot on Arena for text-to-image, single-image editing, and multi-image editing as measured by human preference Elo rankings at the time of writing.
